title: BJP turns on its own civic rule over encroachments; PMC admits decade-long failure

ai.summary: Pune municipal commissioner admitted encroachments on FC Road had remained largely unchanged for nearly 10 years despite BJP corporators protesting the civic body's failure to clear them.
